two R factors, R1 and R2, have the capacity to increase the UV survival of E. coli K-12 approximately 60% in a manner that does not involve improved excisional repair.

the study of the mechanisms of action of R factors.
the effects of ultraviolet radiation on DNA and the mechanisms which cells employ to repair the damage caused by ultraviolet radiation.
the identification and characterization of the genes and functions of R factors which are responsible for the enhanced survival of E. coli K-12 after ultraviolet irradiation.
